mapper.sql: event_id AS eventId, report_id AS reportId, parse_version AS parseVersion, canonical_code AS canonicalCode, critical_level AS criticalLevel, event_status AS eventStatus, detection_time AS detectionTime, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_critical_event (event_id, report_id, parse_version, canonical_code, critical_level, event_status, detection_time, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{reportId}, #{parseVersion}, #{canonicalCode}, #{criticalLevel}, #{eventStatus}, #{detectionTime}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM report_critical_event WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY detection_time ASC, event_id ASC
